V1.classical_restrictions_verified: Simple undirected graph, finite edge transportation costs and pair communication data; all-origin flow model and NP-hard pricing subproblem described.
V1.all_roots_single_arc_objective: no: flow amounts multiply arc costs; pricing also has fixed arc costs
V1.exact_gap: Removing flow charges changes pricing problem to minimum arborescence; no fixed c_r reproducing arbitrary tree-dependent demand amount on every feasible tree demonstrated.

V2.classical_restrictions_verified: One common undirected tree in the full flow model. Independent pricing(5) has nonnegative fixed activation costs, flow costs, at most N-1 arcs, and may omit/prune zero-demand vertices. All-positive nonroot commodity demand is the source's sufficient condition for spanning support.
V2.same_common_tree: yes in coupled full OCSTP; independent pricing permits terminal-subset support with zero demand
V2.all_roots_single_arc_objective: no: full model charges commodity flow; pricing fixed charges do not restore all-root common full spanning support
V2.exact_gap: Zero flow charges can retain fixed-cost Steiner support when vertices are optional. With all vertices mandatory, only the independent fixed-charge pricing problem specializes to minimum rooted spanning arborescence. Neither establishes exact shared-all-root/full-tree target hardness; feasible-set and complete-cost mapping remains unproved.
